facts.fact: AngoLEX carries Angola's Resolução n.º 33/19 of 2019-07-09 on the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection, with the Convention's articles on electronic transactions and personal data; the passages read do not themselves use the word approval, and the document's date is used as the date.
